text:
Aisha (Zephyr): Hey team — since the model rollout last night our retrieval + rerank quality has tanked for clinical queries. We're seeing wrong citations and lower recall. :frowning_face:
Lina (Customer Success): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste one or two failing queries + any request ids/timestamps?
Aisha (Zephyr): Example 1:
```
query: "metformin dosing for elderly with renal impairment"
request_id: req_20260316_0142_aa33
seen_at: 2026-03-16T01:42:17Z
previous_top_citation: NLM_guideline/meddose_123 (was top-1)
current_top_citation: blog_post/hearthealth_77 (now top-1)
```
Aisha (Zephyr): Example 2:
```
query: "preferred anticoagulant for afib with CKD"
request_id: req_20260316_0230_bb88
seen_at: 2026-03-16T02:30:05Z
previous_top_citation: guideline/anticoag_45
current_top_citation: vendor_faq/anticoag_notes
```
Alex (Support Eng): Adding Eng-ML and Runtime to triage. @Maria @Josh can you take a look? Is there a reranker config change in the 02:00-03:00 UTC window?
Maria (Eng-ML): We deployed a reranker variant "rerank-v3" at 2026-03-16T02:41Z intended to boost recency signals and penalize low-quality sources. That could unintentionally de-prioritize canonical guidelines.
Josh (Eng-Runtime): Pulling traces for req_20260316_0142_aa33 now. Can you share the top-5 retrieved doc ids returned to the reranker for that request?
Aisha (Zephyr): Top-5 doc ids for req_20260316_0142_aa33:
```
[doc:NLM_123, doc:hearthealth_77, doc:vendor_faq_21, doc:preprint_09, doc:summary_site_4]
```
Alex (Support Eng): Also seeing a change in reranker score distribution post-rollout — scores are compressed (top-5 closer together). Could be a temp or normalization change.
Maria (Eng-ML): Quick hypothesis: rerank-v3 uses a different feature weight vector (recency + click-signal upweighted, citation-trust downweighted). That would explain guideline demotion. We need to compare feature vectors for these doc ids and the old variant.
SRE Oncall: FYI infra is stable, no rate limiting or errors reported in that window.
Emma (support-bot): Created ticket CS-4742 and linked to this thread.
Aisha (Zephyr): We can provide a small test suite of 12 acceptance queries and expected top citation ids if that helps.
Maria (Eng-ML): Please do. Proposed mitigation: perform a targeted rollback of rerank config for Zephyr org to the previous variant "rerank-v2" while we debug global behavior. Lina, do we have permission to apply org-scoped rollback?
Lina (Customer Success): Aisha — are you okay with a short targeted rollback for your org while we investigate?
Aisha (Zephyr): Yes please — do the rollback. This is blocking clinical surfaces.
Josh (Eng-Runtime): I'll prepare a hotfix route: add a routing rule for org_id: zephyr_org_88 -> rerank-v2 and monitor top-k MRR and grounding accuracy.
Maria (Eng-ML): We'll run a diff job that re-scores the same candidate set with rerank-v2 vs rerank-v3 to quantify regressions. Can you attach logs for two sample request ids (the ones above) and we will produce a short report within 90 minutes.
Aisha (Zephyr): Uploaded logs to the support ticket (link pasted). Thanks.
Lina (Customer Success): I'll own comms with the customer and update them when rollback completes and when we have the initial analysis.
Maria (Eng-ML): If rollback restores grounding we'll schedule a paused global rollout and adjust weights to preserve guideline trust.
Lina (Customer Success): Thanks everyone — monitoring until rollback. :thumbsup:
